author: Bethesda Softworks
description:
Return to the homeland of the Nords in ESO’s Season Two: Echoes of Skyrim and discover new challenges, stories, and treasures in Tamriel’s Second Era. 

Experience over 30 hours of adventures in Skyrim with the Greymoor zone and storyline moving to the ESO base game and venture into two all-new Solo Dungeons, as requested by the ESO community! Unlock new rewards with the Season Two Tamriel Tome, Golden Pursuit campaigns, and in-game events, and enjoy the next wave of player-experience improvements—Tamriel awaits!

ESO’s Season Two is live from October 21, 2026 until January 27, 2027.

Official Site: https://www.elderscrollsonline.com
